notes: Council codes that changed after the boundaries a source was published on. Each entry maps an older code to its May 2025 successor and says what the change was; used only where the source itself is on older boundaries.
The 2023 mergers (Cumbria, North Yorkshire, Somerset) come from the ONS LAD 2022 to LAD 2023 lookup (pipeline/raw/ons/), not from this file.

changes.name: Barnsley
changes.detail: The Barnsley and Sheffield (Boundary Change) Order 2024 (SI 2024/1328) moved a small area, the Oughtibridge Mill housing development, from Barnsley to Sheffield. ONS gave both councils new codes in 2025.
evidence: ONS mid-2025 population tables (S18), Notes worksheet, note 18
